title: Не столько цена, сколько задержка
description: Не столько цена, сколько задержка: словарь, грамматика и авторский текст с объяснениями ответов.
objectives: Понимать not so much A as B как уточнение главного фактора
notes: Not so much the cost as the delay — не столько стоимость, сколько задержка.
Конструкция переоценивает относительную важность факторов, но сама по себе не отменяет первый фактор.

quality.method: author-review + schema/grader/editorial-reference checks; no independent teacher review

exercises.prompt: Выбери точный вариант: It was not so much the price ___ the long wait that mattered.

options.label: В этой конструкции вторая часть вводится as.

exercises.explanation: Вариант выбран по грамматической модели и контексту урока.

exercises.prompt: Вставь слово из пары: timing / timed.

public_payload.sentence: Not so much the venue as the ___ affected attendance.

exercises.editorial_answer: Not so much the venue as the timing affected attendance.

exercises.prompt: Собери предложение: «Беспокойство вызвала скорее задержка, чем стоимость.»
exercises.editorial_answer: It was not so much the cost as the delay that caused concern.
exercises.explanation: Оба фактора названы, больший акцент поставлен на задержке.

exercises.prompt: Исправь ошибку в указанной конструкции, сохраняя остальные слова и смысл.

public_payload.sentence: It was not so much the price than the wait.

accepted: It was not so much the price as the wait.

exercises.reference_answer: It was not so much the price as the wait.
exercises.incorrect_answer: It was not so much the price than the wait.
exercises.editorial_answer: It was not so much the price as the wait.
exercises.explanation: Парная модель использует as, а не than.

public_payload.passage: The board said the reduced attendance was not so much the ticket price as the late schedule change. Prices had stayed the same throughout the season, while the new timetable had been announced only a few days before the event. One commentator paraphrased the statement as saying that price played no role at all. The board clarified that it was ranking the explanations, not proving that every visitor ignored price. It also said that the timing explanation was supported by the feedback they had received, while further evidence would be needed to estimate the effect precisely.

options.label: A price increase during the season.
A complete absence of visitor feedback.

exercises.prompt: Соедини слова с переводом в контексте урока.
exercises.editorial_answer: relative — относительный; factor — фактор; emphasis — акцент; distinction — различие
exercises.explanation: В этих контекстах: relative — относительный; factor — фактор; emphasis — акцент; distinction — различие.

exercises.prompt: Что было неверно в пересказе комментатора?

public_payload.passage: The board said the reduced attendance was not so much the ticket price as the late schedule change. Prices had stayed the same throughout the season, while the new timetable had been announced only a few days before the event. One commentator paraphrased the statement as saying that price played no role at all. The board clarified that it was ranking the explanations, not proving that every visitor ignored price. options.label: It turned a relative emphasis into a claim that price had no role.
It said the schedule had changed late.
It reported that the board had no opinion.

exercises.editorial_answer: It turned a relative emphasis into a claim that price had no role.
exercises.explanation: Совет не отрицал любую роль цены.

exercises.prompt: Сохрани сравнительную, а не абсолютную оценку.

lines.speaker: Собеседник
lines.text: Does not so much A as B prove A had no effect?

options.label: Yes, the first factor disappears in all cases.
Yes, both factors must be identical.
No, it places greater emphasis on B without automatically excluding A.

exercises.editorial_answer: No, it places greater emphasis on B without automatically excluding A.
exercises.explanation: Конструкция ранжирует объяснения, не обязательно обнуляет первое.
